data.text: Lines of latitude: Run in an east-west direction; Equator (0°) divides the Earth into Northern & Southern Hemispheres; Tropic of Cancer (23½°N), Tropic of Capricorn (23½°S), Arctic Circle (66½°N), Antarctic Circle (66½°S)
data.text_origin: Lines of latitude: Run in an east-west direction; Equator (0°) divides the Earth into Northern & Southern Hemispheres; Tropic of Cancer (23½°N), Tropic of Capricorn (23½°S), Arctic Circle (66½°N), Antarctic Circle (66½°S)

data.text: Lines of longitude: Run in a north-south direction between North and South Poles; Prime Meridian (0°) through Royal Observatory Greenwich divides the Earth into Eastern & Western Hemispheres
data.text_origin: Lines of longitude: Run in a north-south direction between North and South Poles; Prime Meridian (0°) through Royal Observatory Greenwich divides the Earth into Eastern & Western Hemispheres

data.text: Housing problems: Severe shortage of affordable housing, long public housing waiting time (5.6 years), world's highest housing prices, overcrowded conditions (subdivided flats)
data.text_origin: Housing problems: Severe shortage of affordable housing, long public housing waiting time (5.6 years), world's highest housing prices, overcrowded conditions (subdivided flats)
data.text_trans: 住房问题：经济适用房严重短缺、公屋轮候时间长达5.6年、全球最高房价、居住拥挤（分隔间）

data.text: Urban decay: Dilapidated old buildings, overcrowded living, lack of open space and community facilities in older urban districts
data.text_origin: Urban decay: Dilapidated old buildings, overcrowded living, lack of open space and community facilities in older urban districts
data.text_trans: 市区衰败：旧楼残破、居住拥挤、旧城区缺乏开放空间和社区设施

data.text: Traffic congestion: Severe bottlenecks during peak hours (Central, Lion Rock Tunnel, Cross Harbour Tunnel); wastes travel time and intensifies vehicle emissions
data.text_origin: Traffic congestion: Severe bottlenecks during peak hours (Central, Lion Rock Tunnel, Cross Harbour Tunnel); wastes travel time and intensifies vehicle emissions
data.text_trans: 交通拥堵：尖峰时段严重瓶颈（中环、狮子隧道、海底隧道）；浪费通勤时间并加剧车辆排放

data.text: Environmental pollution: Air pollution (vehicles, power plants), sewage, noise pollution (roads, construction), solid waste disposal, light pollution (glaring signboards)
data.text_origin: Environmental pollution: Air pollution (vehicles, power plants), sewage, noise pollution (roads, construction), solid waste disposal, light pollution (glaring signboards)
data.text_trans: 环境污染：空气污染（汽车、发电厂）、污水、噪音污染（道路、建筑）、固体废物处理、光污染（刺眼招牌）

data.text: 6.2 What are the causes of these urban problems?
data.text_origin: 6.2 What are the causes of these urban problems?
data.text_trans: 6.2 这些城市问题的成因是什么？

data.text: Four Key Causes
data.text_origin: Four Key Causes
data.text_trans: 四大关键成因

data.text: Small land area & rugged relief: Hilly topography with 40% protected country parks -> Densely populated urban cores and uneven spatial distribution
data.text_origin: Small land area & rugged relief: Hilly topography with 40% protected country parks -> Densely populated urban cores and uneven spatial distribution
data.text_trans: 土地面积狭小且地形崎岖：山地地形，40%为受保护郊野公园→城市核心区人口密集且空间分布不均

data.text: Rapid population growth: Population reaching 7.5 million in 2020 -> Huge demand for housing and infrastructure, leading to overcrowding and pollution
data.text_origin: Rapid population growth: Population reaching 7.5 million in 2020 -> Huge demand for housing and infrastructure, leading to overcrowding and pollution
data.text_trans: 人口快速增长：2020年人口达750万→对住房和基础设施需求巨大，导致拥挤和污染

data.text: Historical lack of urban planning: Unplanned mixed land use and narrow road layouts in old districts
data.text_origin: Historical lack of urban planning: Unplanned mixed land use and narrow road layouts in old districts
data.text_trans: 历史上缺乏城市规划：旧城区未经规划的混合用地和狭窄道路布局

data.text: Rapid economic growth: Soaring commercial land demand, rising resource consumption, and rapid vehicle growth exacerbating traffic congestion
data.text_origin: Rapid economic growth: Soaring commercial land demand, rising resource consumption, and rapid vehicle growth exacerbating traffic congestion
data.text_trans: 经济快速增长：商业用地需求激增、资源消耗上升、车辆数量快速增长加剧交通拥堵

data.text: 8.1 What is a sustainable city?

data.text: Definition & Three Pillars of Sustainability
data.text_origin: Definition & Three Pillars of Sustainability
data.text_trans: 定义与可持续发展的三大支柱

data.text: Definition: A city capable of enduring over time by harmoniously balancing economic growth, social progress, and environmental conservation to meet present and future needs
data.text_origin: Definition: A city capable of enduring over time by harmoniously balancing economic growth, social progress, and environmental conservation to meet present and future needs
data.text_trans: 定义：能够通过和谐平衡经济增长、社会进步和环境保护来长期维持的城市，满足当代与后代的需求

data.text: Economic growth: Fostering a stable, diversified economy that generates adequate employment opportunities
data.text_origin: Economic growth: Fostering a stable, diversified economy that generates adequate employment opportunities
data.text_trans: 经济增长：培育稳定多元化的经济，提供充足的就业机会

data.text: Social progress: Catering to the needs of diverse social groups and continuously elevating public living standards
data.text_origin: Social progress: Catering to the needs of diverse social groups and continuously elevating public living standards
data.text_trans: 社会进步：满足不同社会群体的需求，持续提升公众生活水平

data.text: Environmental conservation: Preserving natural ecosystems and resources while minimizing waste generation and pollution emissions
data.text_origin: Environmental conservation: Preserving natural ecosystems and resources while minimizing waste generation and pollution emissions
data.text_trans: 环境保护：保护自然生态系统和资源，尽量减少废物产生和污染排放
